definitions.explanation: A deep feeling of hostility or ill will toward someone or something. Derived from the verb 憎む (to hate). Stronger and more sustained than 嫌い (dislike).

examples.japanese: {憎|にく}しみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えない→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{憎|にく}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}いていた→抱く：02010_idaku⟧。
examples.english: He harbored hatred toward the culprit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{憎|にく}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: War can leave deep hatred in people's hearts.

notes:
USAGE:
{憎|にく}しみ is a noun form derived from the verb ⟦{憎|にく}む→憎む：00318_nikumu⟧ (to hate). It describes an intense, lasting emotion stronger than simple dislike.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {憎|にく}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧ (harbor hatred)
- {憎|にく}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (feel hatred)
- {憎|にく}しみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧ (hatred fades)
- {憎|にく}しみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連鎖|れんさ}→連鎖：10903_rensa⟧ (cycle of hatred)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{恨|うら}み→恨み：00414_urami⟧ refers to a grudge or resentment, often tied to a specific wrong done to the speaker. {憎|にく}しみ is broader and can be directed at people, groups, or abstract concepts without a personal grievance.
